subject: Livemigration acceptance gate & smoke snapshot
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmecloud.com>, ops@acmecloud.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Livemigration acceptance gate & smoke snapshot

Hi Elena / Acme Ops,

We’re scheduled to move the VPC-hosted tenant for Acme Cloud to the dedicated on-prem routing fabric this Friday. Before we flip traffic, I want to confirm the acceptance criteria we agreed on and make sure the runbook & diagrams are attached. Please confirm the following items are green on your side:

- Network ACLs and BGP peer config verified (no asymmetric paths)
- KV-cache priming plan executed (warmup TTLs set to 72h)
- Healthcheck endpoints (/health/token, /health/kv, /health/metrics) returning HTTP 200 under load
- Canaries (2% of traffic) validated for 30m with no errors >0.5%
- Escalation contact list and bridge details present in runbook

I’m attaching the latest runbook and the networking diagram to this thread. Aditya / Connor — can you call out any last-minute ops caveats (KV warmup schedule, cache priming command, expected token rates)?

Target window: Fri 2027-08-13 02:00–04:00 UTC (we’ll mirror for 30m and then cut).

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Delivery Manager, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: runbook-livemigration-v3.md, networking-diagram-v3.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmecloud.com>, ops@acmecloud.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Livemigration acceptance gate & smoke snapshot

Sofia — ACK and runbook attached (see Sofia’s email). Quick ops notes:

- KV priming: we’ll run the prefix-warmup with the scheduled replay script at T-2 hours. Command: scripts/prefix_warmup.sh --target acme-tenant --duration 90m. Expect ~1.2M tokens per hour during warmup.
- BGP: Confirmed peering with Acme-EDGE-2; we saw a potential community strip on one route previously — fixed earlier today.
- Healthchecks: Added latency SLO on /health/metrics check (p95 < 150ms) to the runbook.
- Fail-open: If canary error rate > 1% within the first 10m we automatically fallback to blue variant (same model, smaller batch size).

I’ve also added a short checklist to runbook-livemigration-v3.md under section 4.2.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Lead Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

> Attachment: runbook-livemigration-v3.md

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmecloud.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 01:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Livemigration acceptance gate & smoke snapshot

Thanks — Acme Ops confirms the acceptance checklist: BGP sessions OK, firewall rules staged in our preflight zone, and our NOC will run the canary mirror. We’ll execute the following at our side:

- Run quick ACL dry-run (no commit) at T-3h
- Mirror 2% traffic for 30m starting T-1h
- Run smoke harness (lua-based http probe) across 3 regions in parallel and collect a CSV of response codes + latencies

We’ll upload smoke output to the Drive folder and reply with results. If anything looks off we’ll open a bridge and escalate to your on-call.

Elena
Elena Martinez
Cloud Ops Manager, Acme Cloud
elena.martinez@acmecloud.com

--
Elena (on behalf of Acme NOC)

Attachment: smoke_harness_config.txt

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmecloud.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Livemigration acceptance gate & smoke snapshot — post-deploy smoke results

Team — quick readout after the Friday window (ops timeline below):

Summary: Cut completed at 02:35 UTC; mirror for 30m; final traffic cut at 03:10 UTC. Observations from post-deploy smoke run:

- Smoke CSV: attached postdeploy-smoke-results-20270811.csv (summary below)
- Health endpoints: all returned 200s during mirror; p95 latency 120ms
- Canaries: 2% mirror for 30m; observed error rate 0.22% (below fail-open threshold)
- KV warmup: prefix replay finished T-15m; cache hit rate at 92% after warmup
- Networking: small TCP retransmit spike (see note) between 02:22–02:28 UTC, peaked at 0.7% of packets; no application-layer errors correlated

Action items / follow-ups:
- Connor to open a short investigation note for the retransmit spike and correlate with edge telemetry (INF-3241)
- Marissa to archive final runbook and update the release notes with the warmup command

All attachments referenced in this thread are uploaded to the shared Drive folder. Please reply with sign-off or if you want a rollback window opened.

Thanks everyone — great coordination.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Delivery Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: postdeploy-smoke-results-20270811.csv

From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Livemigration acceptance gate & smoke snapshot — post-deploy smoke results

Sign-off from platform. Quick notes:

- I’ll spin up a short investigation into the TCP retransmit spike (INF-3241). Initial hypothesis: a transient ARP flap on Acme-EDGE-2 during the mirror period. I’ll correlate with top-of-rack counters and return with a timeline.
- No customer-impacting errors observed in logs; tracing sampled spans show normal tail latencies.
- Marissa / Sofia — recommend we mark this deployment as "Operational" and close the activation checklist after Marissa updates the docs.

Connor Obrien
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
